description: Fix mojibake emoji in onboarding/page.tsx and reconcile the dual i18n systems (lib/i18n.ts vs i18n/index.ts). These are coupled: after fixing the encoding, the file imports from lib/i18n.ts which uses a different LangCode type and localStorage key than the rest of the app. Fixing both together prevents re-introducing inconsistency.
steps: 1. Read the full content of frontend/app/onboarding/page.tsx (all sections including lines 120+) to inventory ALL mojibake sequences and hardcoded English question strings.

2. Replace every garbled icon string in the STEPS array with the correct UTF-8 emoji literal: '≡ƒÄñ'→'📱', '≡ƒæñ'→'👤', '≡ƒÆ╝'→'💼', '≡ƒÆ░'→'💰', '≡ƒî╛'→'🌾', 'ΓÜí'→'⚡', '≡ƒ⌐║'→'♿', 'ΓÖ┐'→'⚕️', '≡ƒæº'→'👧', '≡ƒæ¿ΓÇì≡ƒæ⌐ΓÇì≡ƒæº'→'👨‍👩‍👧', '≡ƒÆ╡'→'💵', '≡ƒÄô'→'🎓', '≡ƒôï'→'📊'. Also fix comment separator lines (ΓöÇ sequences) to plain dashes or ASCII.

3. Check lines 120+ of onboarding/page.tsx for hardcoded English question text (question labels, option labels). Replace any hardcoded English strings with t('onboarding.X_question') or t('gender.Y') etc. using the i18n keys that already exist in hi.ts/mr.ts.

4. In frontend/lib/i18n.ts: change the localStorage key from 'as_lang' to 'arthsathi_lang' in both setLanguage() and getSavedLanguage(). Change LangCode type to 'hi' | 'mr' | 'en' (remove ta, te, bn). Update the LANGUAGES constant to only include hi, mr, en entries (keep ttsLocale/whisperCode fields for onboarding voice use).

5. In frontend/i18n/index.ts: change LanguageCode type to 'hi' | 'mr' | 'en'. Remove ta, te, bn from the LANGUAGES object and the translations registry. This also fixes the LanguageSwitcher to show only 3 options.
6. Run: cd frontend && npm run build — confirm zero TypeScript errors.
acceptance_criteria: frontend/app/onboarding/page.tsx renders correct emoji icons (📱, 💼, 💰, 🌾, ⚡, etc.) — no ≡ƒ or ΓÇ sequences remain in the file.
Switching UI language to Hindi before onboarding shows Hindi question text throughout.
Switching UI language to Marathi before onboarding shows Marathi question text throughout.
LanguageSwitcher dropdown shows exactly 3 options: हिंदी, मराठी, English.
localStorage key 'arthsathi_lang' is used consistently — setting language in switcher persists through navigation to onboarding.
npm run build in frontend/ completes with 0 TypeScript errors.
